forest.scope: Real WASD forest travel, 24 real right-mouse camera samples against actual stem envelopes, canopy flight with discrete travel frames and landing. Does not establish all-route free exploration, airborne trunk body collision or motion antialiasing quality.

compat.scope: Historical v1 save and reload; full west forest spur via real WASD; 24-step real mouse orbit near cliff; rain under shop roof and resource reuse. Not final all-route free exploration.

cliffOrbit.limitation: Real orbit remains finite and outside the target. Structural ray tests validate rock clearance; these samples alone do not prove absence of every tiny corner clipping.
